At a boundary a pending type with an active journal rumor is dropped without a no-lead. (sun-buy capped->covered), 'lift the sighting cap from the carrier reveal on' (rewritten: the cap lift is shown by two free sightings in one snapshot; purchases are covered). 27 typecheck-clean one-line mutations were applied on a scratch copy; each broke a named test (M20 breaks npm run typecheck via TS2578); list is in docs/intel.md 'Tests per branch'. open_assumptions: freeCoverage takes config as its first argument (the task wrote freeCoverage(state, view, player, type)); the reveal tick and eligibility need the config, like every other exported intel function.
answerRequests uses freeCoverage through the phase-2 delivery 'covered' rather than calling it itself, so the step decides once and sends nothing for a covered purchase.
(b) 'pending after gather' excludes a boundary step, where the pending set is decided again as free triggers; a purchase there is answered from that free decision.
The pending drop fires at the next boundary (not in the purchase step) and only when the player holds an active journal rumor of the type.
